I don’t have direct access to Eugene restaurant listings, but I can help you quickly find a good Middle Eastern/Greek place and give you ready-made wording to book 4 people between 6–8pm tomorrow.

1) How to find a place (Middle Eastern / Greek in Eugene)
On Google Maps / Apple Maps / Yelp, search:
- “Middle Eastern restaurant Eugene”
- “Greek restaurant Eugene”
- “Mediterranean grill Eugene”
- “Lebanese restaurant Eugene”

Then:
- Prefer rating 4.0+ if possible
- Check they’re open for dinner tomorrow and open past 8pm
- Glance at a couple of recent reviews mentioning dinner service

Pick 1–3 spots that:
- Are open during your 6–8pm window
- Have solid reviews

2) Phone script to book (for any restaurant)
When you call, you can say:

“Hi, I’d like to make a dinner reservation for tomorrow.  
It’s for 4 people, sometime between 6:00 and 8:00 pm.  

Do you have any openings in that window?  
If so, could you please book us for [chosen time] under the name [YOUR NAME], phone number [YOUR PHONE NUMBER]?”

Shorter version:

“Hi, can I book a table for 4 tomorrow between 6 and 8 pm?  
Any time in that window is fine.  
Name is [NAME], phone is [PHONE].”

3) Online booking / message text
If they have an online form, email, or text, you can paste:

“Hello, I’d like to reserve a table for 4 people tomorrow, anytime between 6:00–8:00 pm (any available time in that window is fine).  
Name: [YOUR NAME]  
Phone: [YOUR PHONE NUMBER].  
Thank you!”

If you tell me:
- The restaurant name you’re leaning toward, and  
- Your ideal time (e.g., “ideally 6:30, otherwise 7–7:30”)  

I can turn that into a very short, specific message you can copy-paste for that exact place and time.</action>
